widgetName.description: Name/key of the widget definition to remove, including every placement across all dashboard pages. Source it the same way as widget.name elsewhere: read it back via render_dashboard, or reuse the widget.name supplied to an earlier upsert_*_widget in this same draft/batch. Never invent it. Distinct from remove_widget_from_page, which only unplaces one page's placement and leaves the definition behind (see edit-dashboard.md §6).
